testo:
■ God Link (tooltip) Right Side (tooltip or tooltip) Top Side
■ This creature gets +2000 power for each of your Gods in your graveyard.
■ Whenever this creature attacks while linked with tooltip, choose one of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone. That creature gets -8000 power until the end of the turn. (A creature that has power 0 or less is destroyed.)
■ If one of your cards that has Suva, Emperor of the Gods in its name leaves the battle zone, you lose the game.
